newsitem.title: USA: Salton/Maxim FY96 includes special items.
newsitem.headline: Salton/Maxim FY96 includes special items.

text.p: Salton/Maxim Housewares Inc said on Thursday that its June 29 fiscal 1996 year results benefitted from an income tax benefit but were reduced by an accounting change.

The marketer of small kitchen appliances and beauty care products said results included an income tax benefit of $3.5 million or $0.52 per share compared with an income tax expense of $20,000 in fiscal 1995.

Due to an accounting change in reporting advertising and promotional costs, net income and per-share results were decreased by about $1.4 million or $0.21 per share in fiscal 1996 and by $553,000 or $0.09 per share in fiscal 1995, the company said.

Salton/Maxim posted full-year earnings of $4.6 million or $0.69 per share compared to $651,000 or $0.11 per share a year earlier. Without the effect of the tax benefit, fiscal 1996 net would have risen to $1.1 million or $0.17 per share.
The company said it believes it is well positioned for fiscal 1997 with the purchase of Block China Corp and its strategic alliance with Winderme Durable Holdings.
